title: Research: rex, Cloudflare agent browser, best agent-harness methods and papers, and testless PHP/WordPress approaches feed KRN tasks
body:
Why: operator 2026-11-14 evening asked: what is "rex" by Mitchell Hashimoto, what is the open-sourced Cloudflare browser for agents, why KRN does not use only the absolutely best methods, architecture patterns and papers, and for more solutions for legacy/testless agency repos (PHP/WordPress), which they rank as very important.
Outcome: one research report (krn-research, extended search, sources) under .krn/runs/market/: what rex and the Cloudflare agent browser are and whether KRN should adopt them (agent-browser skill is the current browser tool); top papers/methods for agent harnesses, memory and code architecture 2025-2026 mapped to KRN gaps; concrete approaches for testless PHP/WordPress repos (characterization/golden-master tests, snapshot of HTTP output, phpunit seams, WP-CLI) feeding t-dcdad8m; every adoptable item becomes a task.
Proof: report file with source URLs; tasks created for each adoptable item.
